name: etch-keeper
description: What a keeper following the published policy WOULD post (src/: reads only, no signer, no code that sends); a LOCAL end-to-end run (local/: chain 31337 only, no key); the STAGING operator (staging/: the staging chain only, this machine only, no key); and the hands of a small real test the USER runs (live/: chain 4663, only for a deployment labelled test, only armed on five facts, key set by the user); and the PRODUCTION keeper (service/: one chain id named by the operator, the key read in service/signer.ts only, dry run unless KEEPER_MODE=send; docs/v6/p1-services.md), with its keyless resolver (service/resolver-main.ts standalone: any funded key, dry run unless RESOLVER_MODE=send).
